structure: Single course document (Grade 6 Middle School Civics, semester-long, second semester of grade 6; 2023 format). Pages 2-3: context/purpose, acknowledgments (backup). Page 4 onward: heading 'Civics Standards (Second Semester Course)', one table; row 1 = course Learning Outcome; topic heading rows (Foundations of Government, Functions of Government, Role of Citizens); standard rows with C1 = code (6.CIV.n) and C2 = standard text, some with inline '● Examples: ...'; '(E)' marks essential standards.
